propositions: Per-field asymmetry policy is scattered across multiple reconciler call sites with no single declarative source, allowing parity bugs to escape

A new field-contract registry module must enumerate reconciled fields with symmetry class (bidirectional-roundtrip / add-wins / one-way-with-propagation-gate) and reference their codec/gate implementations
Property tests parameterized from the registry must assert roundtrip identity for bidirectional fields, merge idempotence for add-wins, and gate-consulted behavior for one-way-gated fields
A coverage guard in the test collection must fail if any field handled by inbound_differ/apply_inbound_records lacks a registry entry
Registry declarations must not trigger behavior refactors; tests verify code matches declarations as-is
Architecture documentation must record the registration contract so future field additions register declaratively
